item_id: encode_decode:stabilization_engineer:place on a soft surface with face up, specified face or location
target_meaning: place on a soft surface with face up, specified face or location
reading: Rest the Veyru on a soft surface (folded cloth on board) with the specified face pointing up, undisturbed. Template form of our REST shorthand.

target_meaning: place on a soft surface with face up, corners
